question: Consider $x(t)$ to be given as, $$ x(t)=\cos (1000 \pi t) $$ . Let the sampling frequency be $700 \mathrm{~Hz}$. Does aliasing occur?

spans.text: According to the Nyquist theorem, the minimum sampling frequency required is twice the highest frequency in the signal.
